record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.context_brief: Travelling waves for discrete-delay memory model
record.original_question: For the discrete-delay scalar movement equation ∂_t u = d1Δu − γ∇·(u∇u_τ) + f(u), do travelling wave solutions exist for fixed delay τ > 0, either without a birth-death term or with a general birth-death term f(u)? If they do, can the wave speed be calculated or estimated, and how does it depend on the delay parameter and the advection and diffusion rates?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 50. Do travelling wave solutions exist solving the discrete delay problem (2.20) for fixed delay τ > 0? This can be explored for either f(u) ≡ 0 or with a general birth/death process f(u). In cases where the answer is affirmative, is it possible to calculate or estimate the wave speed? How does the wave speed depend on the delay parameter τ or the rates of advection and/or diffusion?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the scalar reaction–advection–diffusion equation with a discrete temporal delay
  ∂_t u(x,t) = d_1 Δu(x,t) − γ ∇·( u(x,t) ∇u(x, t−τ) ) + f(u(x,t)),
posed for x ∈ ℝ^n (n = 1 being the primary case of interest) and t > 0, where d_1 > 0 is a diffusion coefficient, γ ∈ ℝ is an advection (memory-taxis) coefficient, τ > 0 is a fixed memory delay, and f : ℝ → ℝ is a smooth birth–death (reaction) term. A travelling wave solution is one of the form u(x,t) = U(x − ct) for some wave profile U : ℝ → ℝ with prescribed (typically constant) limits at ±∞ and wave speed c ∈ ℝ.

Address the following questions:
(a) Do travelling wave solutions exist for the case f ≡ 0?
(b) Do travelling wave solutions exist for general nontrivial birth–death terms f(u) (for instance logistic or monostable/bistable nonlinearities)?
(c) When such travelling waves exist, can the admissible wave speeds c be computed or estimated explicitly?
(d) How does the wave speed depend on the delay parameter τ, the diffusion rate d_1, and the advection rate γ?
artifact.category_tag: Travelling waves in delayed advection-diffusion equations
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published existence/non-existence result for travelling waves of the specific discrete-delay memory-taxis equation ∂_t u = d_1 Δu − γ∇·(u∇u_τ) + f(u). Related literature treats travelling waves for delayed reaction–diffusion equations and for nonlocal/distributed-delay memory models, but the discrete-delay advective form with the term ∇·(u∇u_τ) appears not to have been resolved. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Derivations of animal movement models with accumulated memory
status_evidence.snippet: Animals continuously update their movement decisions using real-time observations and historical information (accumulated memory or distributed delay memory), integrated into advection-diffusion models.
status_evidence.claim: Related memory-based advection-diffusion movement models are still under active investigation, with no resolution of the discrete-delay travelling wave problem reported.

status_evidence.title: Traveling Waves Solutions for Delayed Temporally Discrete Non-Local Reaction-Diffusion Equation
status_evidence.snippet: Studies travelling waves for delayed temporally discrete non-local reaction–diffusion equations, but not the memory-advection form ∇·(u∇u_τ).
status_evidence.claim: Closest available results are for non-local reaction–diffusion with delay, not for the discrete-delay memory-taxis equation in question.
